doc:
# Correlators — Ad SCFT

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “holographic correlation functions”).

claims.name: computed_padic_correlation_functions_match
claims.statement: Computed p-adic correlation functions match ordinary holographic correlation functions when written with local zeta functions.

claims.name: certain_holographic_correlation_functions_necessarily
claims.statement: Certain holographic correlation functions are necessarily real.

sources.title: A Paradox and its Resolution Illustrate Principles of de Sitter Holography

claims.name: boundary_holographic_twopoint_correlation_functions
claims.statement: Boundary holographic two-point correlation functions match higher-rank LCFT two-point functions.

sources.title: Unitary Truncations and Critical Gravity: a Toy Model

claims.name: second_compute_holographic_defect_correlation
claims.statement: Second, we compute holographic defect correlation functions with semiclassical strings.

sources.title: String theory methods for defect CFTs

claims.name: operator_correlation_functions_determined_holographic
claims.statement: Operator correlation functions determined by holographic dictionary for Lifshitz backgrounds

claims.name: fourpoint_functions_holographic_correlation_functions
claims.statement: Four-point functions in holographic correlation functions simplify drastically when expressed in Mellin space

claims.name: magnetic_monopoles_induce_friedel_oscillations
claims.statement: Magnetic monopoles induce Friedel oscillations in holographic density-density correlation functions.

sources.title: Friedel oscillations and horizon charge in 1D holographic liquids

claims.name: correlation_functions_scalar_operators_computed
claims.statement: Correlation functions of scalar operators are computed using holographic real-time techniques.

claims.name: holographic_formulae_relate_all_cosmological
claims.statement: Holographic formulae relate all cosmological 3-point correlation functions, including scalar and tensor perturbations, to stress-energy correlation functions of a dual three-dimensional quantum field theory.

claims.name: novel_definition_holographic_correlation_functions
claims.statement: A novel definition of holographic correlation functions on the celestial sphere was recently introduced as the extrapolation of bulk time-ordered correlation functions to the celestial sphere.

sources.title: Conformal Partial Wave Expansion of Celestial Correlators

claims.name: natural_set_observables_associated_theories
claims.statement: A natural set of observables is associated to these theories, including holographic correlation functions.

claims.name: resulting_correlation_functions_relevant_capturing
claims.statement: The resulting correlation functions are relevant for capturing the switchback effect of holographic complexity.

sources.title: Geometry of Chord Intertwiner, Multiple Shocks and Switchback in Double-Scaled SYK

claims.name: twopoint_correlation_functions_boundary_operators
claims.statement: Two-point correlation functions of boundary operators are computed by non-relativistic holographic methods.

sources.title: A Non-relativistic Logarithmic Conformal Field Theory from a Holographic Point of View

claims.name: numerical_results_holographic_correlation_functions
claims.statement: Numerical results for the holographic correlation functions in anisotropic plasma reveal direction-dependent corrections.

sources.title: Holographic correlation functions of fermions in anisotropic plasma

claims.name: exact_holographic_match_all_sphere
claims.statement: An exact holographic match of all sphere correlation functions of meson operators is proposed.

sources.title: Interface Minimal Model Holography and Topological String Theory

claims.name: correlation_functions_monopole_operators_serve
claims.statement: Correlation functions of monopole operators serve as a diagnostic for the holographic phase diagram.

sources.title: Monopole correlation functions and holographic phases of matter in 2+1 dimensions

claims.name: holographic_calculations_yield_new_predictions
claims.statement: The holographic calculations yield new predictions for correlation functions in CFTs with null boundaries.

claims.name: holographic_methods_applied_bubbling_backgrounds
claims.statement: Holographic methods applied to the bubbling backgrounds reproduce the gauge-theory Wilson-loop correlation functions.

sources.title: Wilson loop correlators at strong coupling: from matrices to bubbling geometries
